record_title: Four-block quantifier undecidability for rich-sequence arithmetic
provenance: A quantifier-hierarchy refinement of the counter-machine encodings in Karimov--Nieuwveld--Ouaknine, arXiv:2609.20415, obtained by stratifying their rank predicates and replacing negative rank tests by a positive two-witness test for counters greater than one.
limitations: The Sigma_4 bound is not claimed optimal; Sigma_3 may still be undecidable by another encoding. The selected-permutation extension here requires a quantifier-free selector, and the predicate-valued LRS and square-free-number constructions are not covered. Originality is to the best of our knowledge, with elevated near-simultaneous priority risk because arXiv:2609.20415 is very recent.
